title: Overlap-aware novelty and improvement gate
description: Changes novelty-gate from a strict novelty-only filter into an overlap-aware research value gate that distinguishes direct duplication from improvable baselines and related-but-different ideas.
changes: Add targeted literature check requirements before each idea is shown to the user.
Add overlap matrix and improvement opportunity requirements.
Add compute/time/data cost estimation to the gate.
Replace REPETITIVE-only rejection with DUPLICATE, OVERLAP BUT DIFFERENT, and IMPROVABLE BASELINE categories.
Forbid treating related work as automatic rejection.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous runtime novelty-gate SKILL.md from repository history if needed.
